desc: Adyen is the financial technology platform built to help global hospitality brands scale faster and deliver seamless guest journeys. Most financial errors in hospitality are not discovered at the point of transaction. They surface later: at month-end close, on a guest's statement, in a payroll dispute, or in an OTA commission that has been quietly shifting for months. Evention is the financial trust layer for hotel, restaurant, retail, and entertainment operators. It delivers trust after checkout by sitting between your transactions and your reporting, continuously validating every financial loop so the number that reaches your ledger, your payroll, and your partners is always accurate. Checkout confirms payment. Evention confirms truth.
